newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian stock indices hit new highs at opening.
newsitem.headline: Italian stock indices hit new highs at opening.

text.p: Italy's blue-chip Mib30 stock index climbed to a new high of 20,673 while the all-share Mibtel index also began at a fresh peak of 13,568 on Wednesday.
The two indices began in their current forms only three to four years ago and Milan market is not quite at all-time highs.
The respected BCI index, which is updated once a day after the market closes, hit 908.20 in 1986. It closed on Tuesday at 834.13.
By 0803 GMT the Mib30 was 1.77 percent higher at 20,889, a new record, while the Mibtel was 1.53 percent firmer at 13683.
